title: Mir on its icon grid

reference.grammar: icon construction sheet: rounded tile, 16 × 64 px grid, keyline circle and square, safe circle, diagonals, center cross, dimension lines and mono notes; the character in one line weight centered on the tile

units: design units, 1000 = plate width; the plate is square. The sheet tile is 680 u for 1024 px.

techniques.name: Tile and corner

tile.label: Tile
tile.note: Tile ink, by role. Mir follows: ink line on accent and light, paper line on deep and ink; the cans keep the accent except on light, where Mir is line only.

corner_pct.label: Corner radius
corner_pct.note: Corner radius as a share of the tile side.

smoothing.label: Corner smoothing
smoothing.note: 0% is a circular arc; 100% is the most continuous curvature the radius allows; the track is front-loaded (square root), and the sheet shows the circular arc as a faint dashed ghost.

techniques.limits: A smoothed corner never runs past the middle of a side, so above a 25% radius the whole track maps onto the smaller range left (at 32%, up to 56%); the note on the sheet shows the smoothing drawn. The track follows a square root, so the first quarter already gives half the smoothing.
techniques.implementation: Each corner is a circular arc of 90° × (1 − smoothing) between two cubic easings, the corner taking (1 + smoothing) × radius of each side (the Figma corner-smoothing construction).

techniques.name: Safe area and keylines

safe_pct.label: Safe area
safe_pct.note: Diameter of the safe circle and side of the safe square, as a share of the tile.

construction.label: Construction
construction.note: Off shows the tile alone. Keylines adds the circles, square, diagonals, center cross and notes. Full grid adds the 16 × 64 px grid.

techniques.limits: Below 64% Mir becomes a badge in an empty tile; above 92% the safe circle meets the corner arcs.
techniques.implementation: All keylines are drawn twice, clipped inside and outside the tile, so they keep contrast on dark tiles. Grid and keylines sit under Mir; the center cross and notes sit over it.

techniques.name: Mir in simple lines

line_px.label: Line weight
line_px.note: Mir’s line at 1024 px; folds take 0.55 of it, thinning to as little as half that when the rows cannot keep one stroke width apart.

size_pct.label: Mir size
size_pct.note: Mir’s inked width as a share of the safe circle diameter, never under 56% of the tile; Mir is centered on its inked box.

techniques.limits: Above 40 px the can faces and the glint start to close. Below 16 px the line reads as a hairline at 120 px and under. Mir’s inked width is held at 56% of the tile or more, so a small safe area and a small Mir never leave a badge in an empty tile.
techniques.implementation: The TS-23 construction at turn 0°, tilt 8°: sphere, band at 12°, decal eyes and mouth, two cans splayed 26.5°, antenna tubes, scalloped folds. Its radius is solved so line plus geometry fills the target width.

techniques.name: Size ladder

optical.label: Optical compensation
optical.note: How much thicker the line gets at 40 px than plain scaling gives (less at larger sizes); 0% scales the line with the icon.

snapping.label: Pixel snapping
snapping.note: On draws each size at its true pixel count with whole-pixel lines, and a loupe under the ladder shows the 40 px icon at a whole-number enlargement.

techniques.limits: The line is held under 0.24 of Mir’s radius at every size, so with a heavy line the compensation runs out early. Rungs keep their true relative sizes; the loupe is never under 2×.
techniques.implementation: Each size keeps the same inked width share. line = weight × N / 1024 × (1 + c × (1024 / N − 1) / 24.6), held under 0.24 R; fold rows = ⌊dome height / max(2.8 × fold line, 7.5 px)⌋, held to 1–3.

techniques.name: Dimension notes
techniques.limits: Notes knock out the lines under them, so they never sit on a keyline.
techniques.implementation: JetBrains Mono capitals at 14 u on the sheet; ladder captions in Inter at 14 u (no dotted zeros); dimension lines with 10 u end ticks; each note sits on a box in the color under it. Inside a colored tile, notes and keylines are set in ink or paper.

pass_order: tile · rounded path in the tile ink
keylines · grid, circles, square and diagonals, inside and outside the tile
Mir · fills, folds, band, decals, cans and antennae in one line
over · center cross, tile outline, dimension lines and notes
ladder · five sizes, vector or snapped pixels
notes: Measured on ref.png (1400 × 1400): tile 1100 px for 1024 (150 to 1250); corner profile matches a circular arc of radius 246 px (22.4%); safe circle 880 px; grid pitch 68.75 px = 64 icon px; Mir line 28 to 33 sheet px ≈ 28 icon px; Mir inked width 766 sheet px = 87% of the safe circle.
Ladder sizes 180, 120, 80, 58 and 40 px from the deck page.
